title: Update #3 - Market Sentinel attempting its first eval
author: gaminggod123
selftext:
Market Sentinel is my automated NAS100 trading system.

In my last update, it had started attempting its first real $100K prop-firm challenge.

Since then, it passed a separate $100K demo challenge in roughly seven trading days:

● 8 trades  
● +$8,176  
● 62.5% win rate  
● 3.87 profit factor

The real $100K attempt is still ongoing. This demo result is encouraging, but eight trades prove very little. It also wasn’t a perfect comparison: the demo used little higher risk and longer trading window.  
I’ve also observed price-feed and execution differences between demo and real accounts, causing slightly different entries, rejected setups and TP levels. That is exactly why I’m forward-testing instead of treating backtests or one demo pass as proof.

For transparency, the BTC trade and the 28-lot and 41-lot NAS100 positions shown in my results were manually executed. Market Sentinel identified the two NAS100 setups, but I do not count them as automated trades.

I post timestamped, day-to-day development updates on X at @SentinelTrades\_ for anyone who wants to follow the experiment.  
This remains a public research journal

Still an experiment no promises or performance claims.
